annotation.title_clean: Spotkanie członków Koalicji AI i innowacji w zdrowiu z Prezesem UODO
annotation.title_en: Meeting of members of the AI and Innovation in Health Coalition with the President of UODO
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Urząd Ochrony Danych Osobowych (UODO), Departament Komunikacji Społecznej
annotation.summary_en: News item from Poland's data protection authority (UODO) on a 29 November 2024 meeting between its President and the AI in Health Coalition. They discussed using patient data to train AI, anonymisation and pseudonymisation standards, NIS2, DORA and the AI Act. UODO pledged to support personal data protection in health-sector law.
key_provisions_or_claims: Meeting covered use of medical data for training AI models
Discussed anonymisation and pseudonymisation standards for medical data
Discussed NIS2, DORA and their relation to the AI Act
UODO committed to supporting data protection guarantees in health-sector legislation
Health sector representatives were interested in complaints about AI processing of medical data
